description: Plan task U18 (replaces T115; re-added with only its real dependencies, owner-approved 2026-10-26). Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. handoff.text: Required fix in src/assets/pdf.ts: U18 specifies that an empty PDF must throw "PDFs must be 25 MB or smaller." before/alongside the header check. inspectPdf currently checks HEADER first, so empty bytes throw "Choose a PDF file." instead. src/assets/pdf.test.ts currently asserts that opposite behavior for empty input. Check size/empty before header and update the test; confirm with `npx vitest run src/assets/pdf.test.ts`. I did not rerun U18 acceptance checks in this review session because the shared serial-check slot is owned by T099 (agent-a3c2); the task log contains the prior cargo/Vitest/tsc results and notes the full-suite timeouts plus isolated 29/29 rerun.

review.note: Cycle 2 approved. Read all scope files against plan U18. pdf.ts: inspectPdf empty/over-25MB -> 'PDFs must be 25 MB or smaller.' checked before header ('Choose a PDF file.'); ids sha256 via shared sha256Hex; verifyPendingPdf checks id/size/hash/meta. assets.ts putPdf/getPdf same DB/STORE/key, verify on write and read. storage.stagePdf (stage_assets) / readPdf (read_asset + inspectPdf + verify; browser throws 'This PDF is not stored in this project.'). Rust: inspect accepts %PDF- as 0x0, cap unchanged, PNG/JPEG zero-dim still rejected (test asserts png(0,3) errs); extension pdf; write_attachments uses is_asset_id before path building, skips missing bytes, never deletes, image loop unchanged; commit still checks image ids only. model.ts: malformed pdf -> 'Invalid research source.', absent fine. RUNS (quiet slot): vitest src/assets src/model.test.ts src/storage.test.ts = 4 files 102 passed; tsc --noEmit exit 0; cargo test --locked --offline --jobs 1 --test-threads=1 = 57 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored, no lockfile change. Gap: no storage.test.ts cases for stagePdf/readPdf -- acceptable (file not in plan; thin wrappers over tested verify/put/get; only the 'not stored' message and desktop invoke shape are unasserted; U19 e2e should cover). TIMEOUT VERDICT: not T124's. adversarial-wp3-exports alone, 2 runs each, current tree vs HEAD scratch copy outside project: current 29/29 and 29/29; HEAD 28/29 (one 5000ms timeout on 'exports clean document with 0 assets') and 29/29. Slowest tests, current vs HEAD (ms): 50-asset stress 2712/4090 vs 2955/2686; 0-asset 2458/3853 vs 5708(timeout)/1996; 1-asset 2282/1375 vs 2722/1644. Same tests are 2-6s under mild load against a 5s limit on both trees; no >1.5x regression. Load flake, pre-existing.
